name: Key Exchange Data 1
definition: Contains data related to key exchange activity.

Control.name: Control
Control.definition: Identifies the key management scheme and associated structure of the remainder of the data element|ISO 13492||Binary, length of 1

KeySetIdentifier.name: Key Set Identifier
KeySetIdentifier.definition: key-set identifier is a number that uniquely identifies a group of related keys that are all different but have certain characteristics in common.|ISO 13492||lengths of 6 or 8

DerivedInformation.name: Derived Information
DerivedInformation.definition: Random number or counter in order to have a unique key per transaction. for example, UKPT PIN encryption or contains the transaction counter.||ISO 13492||Binary, lengths of 5, 8, 16 or 32

Algorithm.name: Algorithm
Algorithm.definition: Selects the encryption algorithm used to encipher the keys contained in the associated key management data element.|ISO 13492

KeyLength.name: Key Length
KeyLength.definition: Specifies the length of the keys being transported, not the encrypting key.|ISO 13492

KeyProtection.name: Key Protection
KeyProtection.definition: Mechanism used to provide key confidentiality and integrity. |ISO 13492

KeyIndex.name: Key Index
KeyIndex.definition: Identifies a unique key set when multiple keys with the same key set identifier are used. for example, key rotation.||ISO 13492||Length of 2 or 5

EncryptedData.name: Encrypted Data
EncryptedData.definition: Uses a structure within it prior to encryption to identify the data.||Binary, length of 8 up to 9999

KeyChecksumValue.name: Key Checksum Value
KeyChecksumValue.definition: Contains a value used to verify a conveyed key. Length depends on the algorithm used. ||Binary, length of 8 up to 9999
